title: Director of Operations - Proliant Dairy Ingredients - Ankeny, Iowa
text:
Proliant Dairy Ingredients is committed to providing the best dairy ingredient options for enhancing the value and effectiveness of our partners’ products. We are formulating success by living our values of Continuous Improvement, Teamwork, Quality, and Leadership. 
 
The Director of Operations provides strategic leadership and oversight of the company’s manufacturing operations, quality, and process engineering functions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and supporting overall organizational performance and growth. As a member of the PDI leadership team, this position works closely with the CEO and senior leadership to drive business growth, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

**JOB QUALIFICATIONS:**
-----------------------

Education:

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* BS or MBA in operations management, engineering, or dairy and/or food science preferred.

 

Experience:

* Demonstrated leadership ability with strong interpersonal skills and a proven ability to build, develop, and motivate high-performing teams.
* Minimum eight years of experience required, with at least five years of production/operations management experience.
* Experience within dairy industry or food processing highly preferred.

**JOB DUTIES:**
---------------

* Lead the development and implementation of operational strategies, policies, and processes to drive efficiency and organizational effectiveness within manufacturing operations.
* Lead and oversee all aspects of employee management for the operations, quality, and process engineering departments, including recruiting, hiring, training, work assignment, performance management, employee development, recognition, and discipline. Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement.
* Evaluate market opportunities and develop recommendations to drive business development and company growth.
* Support raw material sourcing strategies, assist in securing reliable supply commitments, and maintain strong supplier relationships to ensure supply continuity and alignment with business objectives.
* Oversee workplace safety across all PDI U.S. production facilities, ensuring safe working conditions are maintained, and appropriate corrective actions are implemented when necessary.
* Responsible for overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of U.S. production facilities. Keep up to date on dairy processes and techniques.
* Interact, visit, and communicate with various vendors regarding necessary changes to improve operations at all plants.
* Identify areas for improvement in the plants, determine courses of action, and implement improvements and corrective actions in these areas.
* Develop plans for supply and efficient use of materials, machines, and employees.
* Review production costs and product quality, maximize yields, modify production and inventory control programs to maintain and enhance profitable operation of all U.S. Operations.
* Research and assess the viability of new technologies to improve operations.
* Participate in strategic planning process by reviewing PDI operations and recommend budgets for both raw material and capital expenditures.
* Submit necessary requests for capital investment in accordance with established budgets, process, and return-on-investment requirements; present capital investment projects to President & CEO and as necessary to the PDI leadership team.
* Ensures fundamental food safety and quality practices are maintained to achieve food safety and quality objectives and supports ongoing improvements of food safety programs.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS:**
---------------------

* Knowledge of manufacturing, engineering, and operations principles and ability to apply those principles to production management function.
* Ability to effectively communicate and work with management and across multiple departments, as well as with customers and other business contacts.
* Ability to maintain and manage corporate confidential information as well as confidential customer information.
* Knowledge of organizational methods and the ability to manage multiple tasks/projects simultaneously.
* Ability to assist with special or ongoing projects as instructed by senior management.
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret professional journals, technical procedures, or government guidelines.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from internal individuals/groups, suppliers, customers, and the public.
* Ability to analyze data and utilize to drive optimization and problem solving.
* Strong leadership ability in creating a team environment.
* Ability to think strategically and at the same time solve practical problems across a variety of situations.
* Ability to travel as needed to meet job duties (approximately 50%).

**BASIC MENTAL REQUIREMENTS:**
------------------------------

This position requires the mental capabilities to apply technical knowledge surrounding the production and operation of manufacturing plants. Furthermore, the incumbent must assimilate and disseminate operational information, develop plans, and forecast future supply and production trends.

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND EXPOSURES:**
-------------------------------------

Position located in Iowa. Occasional travel (international and domestic) to include spending time in two production plants and laboratory locations (Michigan and Minnesota) and headquarters in Iowa.

**COMPREHENSIVE BENEFITS:**

* A choice of three quality affordable healthcare coverage options
* Vision coverage
* Dental coverage
* Health savings account with employer contribution/flexible spending accounts
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid time off starting at 3 week/annual and 9 paid holidays
